roic.formula: NOPAT / mean(FY opening, closing invested capital)
roic.required_inputs: NOPAT / mean(FY opening, closing invested capital)

gross_profit_to_assets.formula: FY gross profit / FY closing assets
gross_profit_to_assets.required_inputs: FY gross profit / FY closing assets

moat_proxy.formula: mean(return) * max(0, 1-std/mean); mean<=0: mean; >=3 of 5 FY
moat_proxy.required_inputs: mean(return) * max(0, 1-std/mean); mean<=0: mean; >=3 of 5 FY

fcf_to_net_income.formula: (FY CFO - cash CAPEX) / FY NI; NI>0
fcf_to_net_income.required_inputs: (FY CFO - cash CAPEX) / FY NI; NI>0

incremental_roic_5y.formula: (NOPAT FY-NOPAT FY-5)/(IC FY-IC FY-5); delta IC>0
incremental_roic_5y.required_inputs: (NOPAT FY-NOPAT FY-5)/(IC FY-IC FY-5); delta IC>0

incremental_roic_3y.formula: (NOPAT FY-NOPAT FY-3)/(IC FY-IC FY-3); delta IC>0
incremental_roic_3y.required_inputs: (NOPAT FY-NOPAT FY-3)/(IC FY-IC FY-3); delta IC>0

revenue_positive_growth_share.formula: positive annual revenue changes / available changes; >=3 of 5
revenue_positive_growth_share.required_inputs: positive annual revenue changes / available changes; >=3 of 5

revenue_growth_volatility.formula: population std annual revenue changes; >=3 of 5
revenue_growth_volatility.required_inputs: population std annual revenue changes; >=3 of 5

revenue_acceleration.formula: TTM revenue YoY growth - FY3 revenue CAGR
revenue_acceleration.required_inputs: TTM revenue YoY growth - FY3 revenue CAGR

fcf_yield.formula: (TTM CFO - positive cash CAPEX) / positive EV
fcf_yield.required_inputs: (TTM CFO - positive cash CAPEX) / positive EV

own_history.formula: current EBIT/share/price percentile in eligible own historical values
own_history.required_inputs: current EBIT/share/price percentile in eligible own historical values

gap.formula: reverse DCF implied growth - realized FY3 revenue CAGR
gap.required_inputs: reverse DCF implied growth - realized FY3 revenue CAGR
